title: [v0.92][WP-18A-HTML] Complete live HTML Observatory Runtime v3 integration
body:
## Summary

Complete the HTML Observatory as the first live vertical slice of the Observatory's Layer 8 human-agent communication surface. The Layer 8 operator selects a visible agent and sends an ordinary signed chat message through Runtime v3; the same interaction is sufficient to wish the first agent happy birthday without any birthday-specific control.

Part of #110. This issue supplies the browser interaction required by legacy birthday-demo issue danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5836; it does not depend on that issue.

## Goal

Make the checked-in HTML Observatory a truthful live Runtime v3 consumer and the first usable conversation surface between a Layer 8 human operator and an allowed agent.

## Required Outcome

The real Observatory shows the live agent roster and status, lets the Layer 8 operator select one agent, submits a signed ordinary message through canonical Runtime ingress, displays only the correlated bounded response, and preserves explicit denial, offline, trust, and reconnect states.

## Deliverables

- Live agent roster and selected-agent chat in the existing Observatory.
- Canonical signed `layer8_message` ingress through the production Runtime assembly.
- Bounded typed public response projection with recipient and correlation checks.
- Explicit denial for unknown recipients and malformed content without authority escalation.
- Local in-memory signing-key selection with no key, token, or private agent state rendered or logged.
- Playwright live Runtime validator with retained browser evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The operator sees the live agent list and each visible agent's current status.
- A normal message to the selected visible agent enters the production Runtime through the canonical `agent` ingress alias and produces a correlated bounded response.
- Unknown recipients, malformed content, invalid signatures, TLS/origin failures, and unavailable Runtime remain denied or visibly unavailable.
- Public, operator, and reviewer projections do not expose signing material, tokens, arbitrary provider output, or private citizen state.
- Reconnect uses bounded cursor/deduplication behavior and does not duplicate chat turns.
- The retained browser proof demonstrates a real signed happy-birthday message, a Runtime refusal, stop/reconnect, and a clean browser console against the exact candidate.
- Focused Runtime control, production assembly, OpenAPI, shell, syntax, and diff-hygiene validation pass.
- One exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings.

## Owned Paths

- `demos/html-observatory/app.js`
- `demos/html-observatory/index.html`
- `demos/html-observatory/styles.css`
- `adl/tools/validate_v092_html_observatory_live.mjs`
- Narrow Runtime ingress, assembly, control, contract, and focused-test changes required by this vertical slice

## Dependencies

- Legacy #5800 trusted browser HTTPS is terminal.
- Legacy #5820 stable Runtime launch and API behavior is terminal.
- Legacy #5832 versioned HTTP/WSS protocol contract is terminal.
- #83 supplies the live browser interaction and evidence required by legacy #5836.
- Legacy #5837 may consume the completed browser hooks for shared cross-client reconciliation but does not gate this lane.

## Non-Goals

- No birthday-only endpoint, control, or UI.
- No Unity implementation or shared cross-client coordinator.
- No provider-specific free-form cognition transcript; #111 owns the canonical multi-turn conversation contract.
- No durable conversation history, multi-agent rooms, attention inbox, or production hardening; those are tracked by #114 through #117.
- No AWS work and no Observatory-wide visual redesign.

## Issue Graph

- #110 is the Observatory-as-living-Polis umbrella.
- #83 is the first complete operator-to-agent communication vertical slice.
- #111 through #117 complete canonical sessions, Layer 8 governance, full roster/presence, durable history, rooms/routing, operator attention, and production hardening.
- Completion of #83 does not independently complete legacy parent danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5837.
